name: Daily Routine

parameters.subject: =Daily Routine – {{ $json.date }}
parameters.message:
=

Your Daily Routine – {{ $json.date }}

{{ $json.summary }}

Sent by EverythingApp • n8n pipeline

parameters.responseBody: ={ "ok": true, "message": "Daily routine email sent for {{ $('Parse Input').item.json.date }}" }

notes:
Phase 4 — Daily Routine pipeline.

Setup:
1. Import this workflow in n8n.
2. Set N8N_FROM_EMAIL and N8N_TO_EMAIL environment variables in n8n.
3. Create a Resend credential in n8n with the N8N_RESEND_API_KEY (from .env).
   IMPORTANT: use a SEPARATE Resend domain from Skarpa Bytom.
4. Activate the workflow.
5. The MCP trigger path is 'daily-routine' — the full URL will be:
   http://n8n:5678/mcp/daily-routine (internal Docker URL)
6. Add to everythingapp-web env:
   MCP_N8N_URL=http://n8n:5678
   MCP_N8N_API_KEY=(the n8n webhook auth header value)

Agent call example:
  Tool: n8n__daily_routine
  Args: { "summary": "Today I finished Phase 4 of EverythingApp.", "date": "2026-09-22" }
